long_biography.plain_text:
Fort Lauderdale investor Tom McManus has taken an active role in improving the city's beachfront neighbourhoods. He leads Friends of North Beach Village, whose work includes streetscape improvements on Breakers Avenue and support for local businesses. The organisation also promotes the area's mid-century architecture and seeks a safer, cleaner neighbourhood for residents and visitors.

At the Jack & Jill Center, he served on the board and co-chaired the campaign to build its new elementary school. The fundraising helped extend the centre's provision beyond early childhood, giving children a longer period of support within the same organisation.

A secondary gaming-industry article conflates the Lily founder with a former NFL player; it is not evidence for sporting history, birth date or family. The regulatory legal name is independently anchored to the firm and employment history.

Personal property ownership and enterprise creation are established, but individual equity shares, starting capital and present portfolio weights are not public. Managed assets are not his net worth. The historical disclosure uses 2012; current firm materials use 2013. The biographies omit an exact formation year rather than resolve this administratively.

The regulator's historical employment fields are not current professional-registration claims. The current family-office and own-capital evidence supports his present relationship separately from the sector fallback. Individual company names or property roles do not establish dominance of an underlying sector today.

Birthplace, birth date and secondary nationality remain unverified. Forbes was checked first. LinkedIn and the company website are verified; the Zillow match is supported by specific affiliation. Searches also covered Instagram, personal websites, Facebook, X, YouTube, TikTok, Wikipedia, Vimeo, Flickr and Trip Advisor. No additional attributable personal account was established; TikTok access was blocked. The company-branded X account is not substituted for a personal profile.

Some direct readers failed while substantial indexed source bodies remained available, as recorded individually. An old company category path served unrelated spam on direct opening and is excluded; the original corporate announcement was instead read at PR Newswire. No unsolicited health, disputes or private-family detail is included.

Incidental portfolio sectors and charity domains are retained in ordinary narrative without new taxonomy candidates.
